title: Incremental Embed+Rerank Gateway: dynamic model stitching and deprecation runway
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: New embedding variants are arriving rapidly (quantized and dense-optimized). The reranking endpoint (embed -> candidate score -> rerank) currently assumes a single canonical embedding model per alias which forces large tenant migrations and causes either latency spikes or quality regressions during swaps. Goal: introduce an incremental "stitching" gateway that can route portions of the embed+rerank flow to different model versions (mix-and-match at request granularity), provide tenant-specific deprecation runways, and implement latency-aware backpressure so high-throughput tenants do not regress SLA during onboarding. This ticket covers design, implementation, rollout, and post-rollout monitoring for the gateway and related migration tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway can route embed calls and rerank scoring to different model versions within the same request flow based on routing rules
Per-tenant runway config exists to pin traffic percentages to old/new embedding models with a TTL-based deprecation schedule
Latency-aware circuit breaker triggers per-tenant and per-model when 95th percentile token latency exceeds configured SLO for 3 consecutive windows
Automated golden-set rerank regression checks run as part of canary and block rollout on >2% semantic delta
End-to-end p95 for rerank endpoint does not regress by more than 10% for tenants in the canary group compared to baseline
Migration tooling produces per-tenant compatibility report (kv cache shape, vector dims, quantization flags) before traffic split
Comprehensive telemetry ingested into console dashboards: per-model success rate, semantic delta, per-tenant cost delta, latency distributions
implementation_plan: Design API extension: include model_stitching_hint in /embeddings and /rerank payloads; update OpenAPI and SDKs
Build gateway module that accepts a routing config and executes embed->rerank subcalls, merging scores deterministically
Implement routing engine: weight-based splits, latency circuit breakers, and tenant runway enforcement
Extend KV/cache layer to support multi-model keys and a migration compatibility layer to avoid cache poisoning
Add golden-set eval pipeline for rerank scoring differences with automated significance testing
Create migration CLI to generate per-tenant compatibility reports and propose initial split percentages
Add telemetry hooks (span tags, model fingerprints) and wire into console dashboards and alerting rules
Write canary runbook and rollback playbook; add automatic rollback if semantic delta or latency SLOs breach
rollout_plan: Internal shadow run across staging cluster with canonical and candidate embeddings (2 weeks)
Canary: enable 5% traffic for 30 tenants picked by support + low-risk cohorts, monitor 48 hours
Increase to 20% for additional tenants if no regressions and circuit-breakers stable (72 hours)
Tenant-by-tenant runway: expose UI to PMs to set deprecation TTL and opt-out
Gradual fleet-wide rollout with automated scheduling and forced rollback triggers
Sunset old model alias after >90% tenants migrated and 4 weeks of stable telemetry
telemetry_and_metrics: Per-request model fingerprint (sha1) and route used
Embedding dimension and quantization flag per call
p50/p95/p99 token latency for embed and rerank stages by model and tenant
Semantic delta metric: normalized rerank delta against golden set
Per-tenant cost delta (tokens + model compute ms) and SLO breach counters
Circuit-breaker activation counts and duration by tenant/model
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Cache incompatibility causes corrupted rerank inputs. Mitigation: add compatibility check in migration CLI and namespace cache by model_fingerprint
Risk: Increased tail latency due to dual-model subcalls. Mitigation: latency-aware breaker and async fallback that uses cached embeddings for tail requests
Risk: Semantic regressions undetected by small golden sets. Mitigation: maintain 3 diverse golden sets (small/medium/large queries) and sample live traffic for blind A/B evaluation
Risk: Operator confusion with runway UI. Mitigation: default conservative splits, clear warnings, and one-click rollback
